verses.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
verses.sm: ONA fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou i faataoto, Na tot5 e le tasi tagata le tovine, ua ia lotoāina i le āi, ua eli foi le mea e tali ai le suāvine, ua fai foi le ‘olo, ua tuuina atu i e galulue i vine, ona alu malaga lea o ia i le nuu ese.

verses.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
verses.sm: Ua fai le fuata, ona auina atu lea e ia le auauna i e galulue i vine, ina ia piaua ni fua o le tovine i e galulue i vine.

verses.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.sm: A ua latou pue ia te ia, ma sasa, ma aufuaina mai o ia.

verses.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
verses.sm: Ona toe auina atu lea e ia o le tasi auauna ia te i latou; ona latou fetogi lea ia te ia i maa, ua foa lona ulu, ma auina mai o ia ua agaleagaina.

verses.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
verses.sm: Ua toe auina atu foi e iale tasi; ua latou fasiotia lava o ia; o isi foi e toatele, ua latou sasaina nisi, a ua fasioti nisi.

verses.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.sm: Ona toe lea ia te ia na o lona atalii e toatasi, ua faapelepeleina e ia, ua muliai auina atu o ia ia te i latou, ua faapea ana, Latou te ava mai i lo‘u atalii.

verses.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
verses.sm: A o ia tagata galulue i vine, ua latou fetautalatala‘i, O le suli lenei; ina o mai ia, tatou fasioti ia te ia, ona fai ai lea o le fanua mo i tatou.

verses.en: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
verses.sm: Ona latou pue lea ia te ia, ma fasioti, ma lafo i tua o le tovine.

verses.en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
verses.sm: O lenei, se a se mea e faia e le alii e ona le tovine ? E sau o ia, ma faaumatia na tagata galulue i vine, ma tuu ane le tovine i nisi.

verses.en: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
verses.sm: Ua outou le faitau ea lenei upu a le Tusi, O le maa na lafoaiina e tufuga fai fale, ua fai lea ma maa tulimanu aupitoaluga ;

verses.en: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.sm: o le mea lea na faia e le Alii, tatou te ofo ai pe a tatou vaavaai atu i ai ?

verses.en: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
verses.sm: Ona latou fia pue ai lea ia te ia, a ua latou matatau i le vao tagata; auā ua latou iloa, na ia faatu le faataoto ia te i latou ; ua latou tuua o ia, a e o ese.

verses.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
verses.sm: Ona latou aauina mai lea ia te ia nisi o le au faresaio ma nisi o le au Herotiano, latou te mailei ia te ia i ana upu.

verses.en: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
verses.sm: Ua latou oo mai, ona faapea mai lea ia te ia, Le a‘oaco e, ua matou iloa ua e faamaoi lava, ma ua e le mata‘u i se tasi, auā ua e le faailogaina se tagata ; a e peitai ua e a‘oa‘0 faamaoni lava i le ala o le Atua; pe sa ea ona avatu le taulaga ia Kaisara pe leai ? a matou avatu ea? pe matou te le avatu ?

verses.en: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
verses.sm: A ua silafia e ia lo latou pepelo, ona fetalai atu ai lea ia te i latou, Se a le mea tou te tofotofo mai ai ia te au ? ina au mai ia ia te au se tenari, se‘i ou matamata i ai.

verses.en: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
verses.sm: Ona latou avane lea. Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, O ai ea e ona lenei faatagata, ma lenei tusi ? Ona latou fai mai lea ia te ia, E o Kaisara.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, Ina avatu ia o mea a Kaisara ia Kaisara ; ia avatu foi mea a le Atua i le Atua. Ona latou ofo ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
verses.sm: Ona o mai lea ia te ia o satukaio, o e taofi, e leai se toe tu ; ua latou fesili mai ia te lana faapea mai,

verses.en: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.sm: Le a‘oa‘0 e, ua tusi mai Mose ia te i matou, Pe a oti le uso o le tasi tagata, ma tuu ai lana avā a e leai se fanau, ona fai lea o lana avā ma avā a lona uso, e faatupuina ai se gafa mo lona uso.

verses.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
verses.sm: Ia, sa i ai le au uso e toafitu ; na fai avā le ulumatua, ua oti foi, ua leai se fanau.

verses.en: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
verses.sm: Ona fai avā lea ia te ia o le aupito ane i ai, ua oti foi ia, ua leai foi sana fanau ; ua faapea foi lona toatolu.

verses.en: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
verses.sm: Atoa uma le toafitu ua fai avā ia te ia, a ua leai lava se fanau. A e muliai oti le fafine.

verses.en: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
verses.sm: O lenei, a oo i le toe tu, pe a toe tu mai i latou, o ai so latou e ana le avā; auā sa fai avā le toafitu ia te ia ?

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, E le o lenei ea ua outou sese ai, ina ua outou le iloa upu o Tusi, ma le mana o le Atua?

verses.en: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
verses.sm: auā pe a latou toe tutū mai i e ua oti, latou te le fai avā pe nofo tane ; a e peitai latou te faapei o agelu o i le lagi.

verses.en: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
verses.sm: A o e ua oti, ma lo latou toe tu, ua outou le faitau ai ea i le tusi a Mose, i le laau talatala, na fetalai mai le Atua ia te ia, ua faapea, O a‘u o le Atua o Aperaamo, o ie Atua foi o Isaako, o fe Atua foi o Iakopo ?

verses.en: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
verses.sm: E le o le Atua iao e ua oti, a o le Atua o e ola; o lea, ua tele ai lava lo outou sese.

verses.en: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
verses.sm: Ua sau foi le tasi o le au tusiupu, ua faalogo ane i la latou fesilisili, ua na iloa ua mālie ana sa tali atu ai ia te i latou, ona fesili mai lea o ia ia te ia, Po o le fea poloaiga e sili i poloaiga uma ?

verses.en: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o lesu ia te ia, E sili lenei i poloaiga uma, Faalogo mai ia Isaraelu e; o le Alii lo tatou Atua, o le Alii e toatasi ia.

verses.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.sm: Ia e alofa foi i le Alii lou Atua ma lou loto ato'a, ma lou agaga atoa, ma lou manatu atoa., ma lou malosi atoa. O le poloaiga sili lea.

verses.en: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.sm: E faapena foi lona lua, o lenei, Ia e alofa atu i le lua te tuaoi, ia pei o oe lava ia te oe. E leai lava se tasi poloaiga e sili i na poloaiga.

verses.en: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tusiupu ia te ia, Mālie a oe le a‘oa‘o e, o le tonu lea ua e fetalai mai na; auā e toatasi lava le Atuā ; e leai lava se tasi ua na o ia.

verses.en: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.sm: Ia alofa foi ia te ia ma le loto atoa, ma le manatu atoa, ma le agaga atoa ma le malosi atoa ; ma ia alofa i le la te tuaoi e pei o ia lava ia te ia, e sili lea I taulaga mu atoa, ma taulaga uma.

verses.en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.sm: Ua silafia e lesu ua tali' mai o ia ma le atamai, ona fetalai atu lea ia te ia, E te le vava mamao oe ma le malo o le Atua. Talu ai ua le toe faamalosi se tasi e fesili ia te ia.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
verses.sm: Ua a‘oa‘o lesu i le malumalu, ona fetalai atu lea o ia, ua faapea atu, Pe faapefea ona fai mai o le au tusiupu, o le Keriso o le atalii ia o Tavita ?

verses.en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.sm: auā ua fai mai Tavita lava e le Agaga Paia, Ua fetalai mai le Alii 1 Io‘u AHI, Ia e nofo i lo£u itu taumatau, seia ou faia e ua ita mai ia te oe ma mea e tu ai ou vae.

verses.en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua ta4ua o ia e Tavita lava, o le Alii; pe faapefea ona avea o ia mona atalii ? Ua faalogo foi ma le fiafia le motu o tagata e toatele ia te ia.

verses.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou i lana a‘oa‘o atu Ia outou i le au tusiupu, o e ua fia evaeva ma ofu tatapuvae, ma ia alofaina i latou i malae,

verses.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.sm: atoa rna nofoa sili i sunako, ma mea sili e taoto ai i faigaai.

verses.en: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.sm: Ua latou faauma fale a fafine na oti a latou tane, ma faalevaleva le tatalo e fai ma ufiufi, e atili ai ona faasalaina o i latou.

verses.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.sm: Sa nofo Iesu e feagai ma le mea e teu ai tupe, ua silafia foi e ia le vao tagata o lafo tupe i le mea e teu ai tupe ; e toatele foi o e mauoa,

verses.en: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.sm: ua tele a latou ua lafo i ai. Ua alu ane foi le tasi fafine mativa ua oti lana tane, na lafo ane ai tupe iti e lua, o le kotane e tasi ia.

verses.en: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.sm: Ona valaau atu lea o ia i ona soo, na fetalai atu ia te i latou, E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, o mea a lena fafine mativa ua oti lana tane, ua lafo i le mea e teu ai tupe, ua sili ia i a latou uma na lafo i ai;

verses.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.sm: anā o i latou uma, ua latou lafo nisi mea mai a latou mea ua tele ; a o ia ua mativa ua ia lafo ana mea uma sa ia te ia, o ana mea uma e ola ai. 0 le valoaga a lesu i le faaumatia ō
